description: Everything our desk recorded on a Solana mint in the last 48 h: the safety gate result (with rugcheck.xyz numbers, attributed), scout scores (numbers), our grade from scanner-card fields, the trader's action and conviction, the shadow outcomes (return at 1/5/15/60 min, max favourable / adverse excursion) and our last closed paper trade. No trader thesis, no bot card text, no chat content. Mints the desk never saw answer 404 and are not charged. Data rewritten every 30 s; refused (503, not charged) if older than 180 s. Research data from our own paper-trading desk, not trading advice. Costs $0.02 USDC per call (x402).
name: sol_token_verdict
